iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: Reuters May 4/5 says US intelligence sees limited new damage to Iran nuclear capability and IAEA still cannot verify roughly 440 kg of 60% uranium or access/status at damaged facilities. No newly verified higher-level enrichment or device event; inspection blind spot remains acute. Probability 61%. Stable/imminent.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: Reuters/CBS search continues to show US-Iran blockade/Hormuz constraint, small-boat clashes and crude-market stress; Reuters also reports possible renewed US-Iran talks this week. Kinetic maritime risk remains extreme, with a small diplomatic offset. Probability 86%. Stable/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: Al Jazeera/AFP results still show Israeli attacks and displacement/strike orders in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire architecture. turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: Turkey remains primarily a mediation and balancing actor in Russia-Ukraine/Middle East coverage; no fresh Turkish kinetic trigger found. Probability 11%. Falling/elevated.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: India-Pakistan search remains dominated by stale 2025 Kashmir crisis retrospectives; no fresh 24h mobilization, missile, or cross-border strike signal found. Probability 7%. Stable/deterrent.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: No new Russian nuclear alert posture found; NATO criticism of Russian/Chinese nuclear posture remains background. Coupling from Ukraine deep strikes sustains critical Russia-NATO risk. Probability 36%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China
china.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: Reuters results are still centered on April PLA Taiwan pressure and Beijing rejection of US pressure claims; no fresh blockade/live-fire trigger in past-24h scan. Probability lowered to 42%. Falling/critical.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: Current search surfaces April 19 ballistic missile activity and lower-quality reposts but no confirmed fresh DPRK launch or atomic detonation event or alert change. Technical signal decays to elevated. Probability 24%. Falling/elevated.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: BBC/Reuters report Ukraine expanding medium/long-range strikes on Russian oil infrastructure including Perm, while Russia continues aerial attacks and Putin offers only a brief Victory Day ceasefire. Escalation remains imminent. Probability 66%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 6 morning deep scan: Al Jazeera reports Kabul accused Pakistan of a Kunar cross-border attack killing three civilians and wounding 14, testing the China-brokered ceasefire; Pakistan denies. Probability 31%. Rising/critical.
